woba.text: Weighted On-Base Average: combines all the different aspects of hitting into one metric.

wraa.text: Weighted Runs Above Average: the non-park-adjusted version of Batting Runs.

wrc.text: Weighted Runs Created: an improved version of Bill James' Runs Created, in runs.

wrc_.text: wRC+: how a player's wRC compares with league average after controlling for park effects.

fip.text: Fielding Independent Pitching: what a pitcher's ERA would look like with typical results on balls in play.

xfip.text: Expected FIP: a regressed version of FIP that uses the league-average HR/FB rate on fly balls.

siera.text: Skill-Interactive ERA: an ERA estimator meant to show a pitcher's underlying skill level.

babip.text: Batting Average on Balls In Play: how often a ball in play goes for a hit.

iso.text: Isolated Power: a measure of a hitter's raw power, how often a player hits for extra bases.

k_.text: Strikeout rate: the share of plate appearances that end in a strikeout (K / PA).

bb_.text: Walk rate: the share of plate appearances that end in a walk (BB / PA).

war.text: Wins Above Replacement: an attempt to summarize a player's total contributions to the team.

ubr.text: Ultimate Base Running: the value a player adds through base running on non-stolen-base plays.

spd.text: Speed Score: a Bill James statistic that rates a player on speed and baserunning ability.

uzr.text: Ultimate Zone Rating: puts a run value to defense.

rngr.text: Range Runs: whether a fielder reaches more balls than average at their position.

dpr.text: Double-Play Runs: runs an infielder adds above average by turning double plays.

errr.text: Error Runs: runs gained or lost by committing fewer or more errors than a league-average player at the position.

o_swing_.text: Swings at pitches outside the zone divided by pitches outside the zone.

z_swing_.text: Swings at pitches inside the zone divided by pitches inside the zone.

o_contact_.text: Contact made on pitches outside the zone divided by swings on pitches outside the zone.

z_contact_.text: Contact made on pitches inside the zone divided by swings on pitches inside the zone.

contact_.text: Pitches on which contact was made divided by swings.

zone_.text: Pitches in the strike zone divided by total pitches.

f_strike_.text: First-pitch strikes divided by plate appearances.

swstr_.text: Swings and misses divided by total pitches.

gb_.text: Ground Ball Percentage: ground balls divided by balls in play.

fb_.text: Fly Ball Percentage: fly balls divided by balls in play.

ld_.text: Line Drive Percentage: line drives divided by balls in play.

iffb_.text: Infield Fly Ball Percentage: infield fly balls divided by fly balls.

lob_.text: Left On Base Percentage: the percentage of base runners a pitcher strands on base.
